title: Automated Report Generation Pipeline
summary: Architected an automated data pipeline that replaced entirely manual Excel-based weekly reporting — delivering data extraction, comprehensive EDA, and dynamic visualization generation on a scheduled basis.
problem: Business analysts spent hours each week manually pulling data, running analysis in Excel, and copy-pasting charts into PowerPoint reports. The process was repetitive, error-prone, and produced inconsistent outputs.
solution: Independently designed and built a full automation pipeline: scheduled data extraction from PostgreSQL, automated EDA with anomaly flagging, dynamic chart generation, and templated report assembly — all triggered on a cron schedule.
achievements: Fully eliminated repetitive manual Excel-based weekly reporting process
Automated data extraction, EDA, anomaly detection, and chart generation
Dynamic visualization generation with consistent formatting and branding
Scheduled pipeline delivering reports automatically to stakeholders

architecture.title: Pipeline Architecture
architecture.content: Cron-triggered pipeline: (1) Data extraction layer pulls structured data from PostgreSQL with configurable date ranges; (2) EDA engine computes KPIs, trend analysis, and flags statistical anomalies; (3) Visualization engine generates charts via Matplotlib/Plotly; (4) Report assembler injects charts and tables into Jinja2-templated outputs; (5) Delivery layer emails final reports to stakeholders.
